notes: Day headings are each day's stop line (journeyTextRows locations, joined with ' → '); the day titles (e.g. 直航北海道輕鬆展開旅程) are used only for a day with no stops. Start and end are the outbound origin and return destination in the transport blocks (出發交通資料 / 回程交通資料): 香港 both, so start and end are Hong Kong. Departures: all four dates in the dates JSON (none isFull or isOffline), each with its own sellingPrice; the from price is JSON-LD offers.price. Route: 札幌 (直航札幌), 登別 (day 3 stops), 小樽 (day 4), 北廣島 (day 6 北廣島OUTLET購物城); 登別 and 北廣島 were added to places data.json, without 北廣島 the outlet would have matched 廣島 (Hiroshima). The 北海道 in day 2's ROYCE stop gives no stop (北海道 is in notPlaces).
